title: Predicator conformance runner report
description: The shape a sibling's runner emits after running one surface at one tier against the corpus. This repo does not write a runner (px-35i.8); this schema is the contract a runner's output is checked against. The per-case result enum is exactly ["pass", "fail"] - the structural half of the never-skip rule (conformance/README.md): a feature the runner has not implemented yet is a fail naming the reason, never a skip, because skip is not a representable value here.

isa_version.description: The ISA version the runner claims to support.

corpus_hash.description: The manifest.json corpus_hash this report was run against.

tier.description: The highest tier run. Running tier N means every case in tiers 1..N was run, not tier N alone.

surface.description: evaluator: run instructions, compare to expected_result/expected_error. compiler: parse source, compare emitted instructions structurally. A case with source: null is absent from the compiler surface's case set, not run and not skipped by it.

results.description: One entry per case the runner attempted, in any order.

id.description: The case id from the corpus.

result.description: No skip value. A case whose feature is unimplemented is a fail naming that feature in reason, not an absent or skipped entry.

reason.description: Required when result is "fail"; a short, structured explanation (e.g. an unimplemented feature tag, or the expected vs. actual value). Free text, not normative - unlike expected_error's type/reason on a case itself.
